PP-OCRv5 mobile local OCR models

Upstream OCR model authors: Baidu / PaddlePaddle / PaddleOCR contributors.
ONNX conversion and reference implementation: RapidAI / RapidOCR contributors.
Copyright (c) 2021 RapidOCR Authors. All rights reserved.
Reference package: RapidOCR 3.10.0. Apache License, Version 2.0.
This extension is not endorsed by PaddleOCR, Baidu, or RapidAI.

ch_PP-OCRv5_det_mobile.onnx
SHA-256: 4d97c44a20d30a81aad087d6a396b08f786c4635742afc391f6621f5c6ae78ae
en_PP-OCRv5_rec_mobile.onnx
SHA-256: c3461add59bb4323ecba96a492ab75e06dda42467c9e3d0c18db5d1d21924be8

English and detector weights are copied byte-for-byte from the frozen 11 October 2026 experiment.
They are separate from the installed 2 October Tesseract model.
The browser adapter is a new implementation based on the version-pinned
RapidOCR/PaddleOCR algorithms. New CJK and Korean source languages are beta.
Upstream source: https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR
PaddleOCR source/license: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR

Pinned model registry: RapidOCR 3.10.0, default_models.yaml.
Detector source:
https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RapidAI/RapidOCR/resolve/v3.10.0/onnx/PP-OCRv5/det/ch_PP-OCRv5_det_mobile.onnx
English recognizer source:
https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RapidAI/RapidOCR/resolve/v3.10.0/onnx/PP-OCRv5/rec/en_PP-OCRv5_rec_mobile.onnx
Character dictionaries are extracted from each pinned recognizer's metadata.
English identity is recorded in paddle-version.json; all language identities
and character counts are recorded in vendor/paddle/languages.json.
These URLs are provenance only; runtime
models and executable code are loaded exclusively from the extension package.

Browser adaptation changes: JavaScript pixel processing and geometry,
worker and queue integration, CTC/source coordinate conversion. Custom polygon
offset and raster rounding are approximate and have not passed full reference
parity. Source-language and vertical/column reading-order handling are local
adaptations and are not upstream reference accuracy claims.

Additional multilingual recognizer weights, acquired 21 October 2026 from
the same version-pinned official RapidOCR model registry:

https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RapidAI/RapidOCR/resolve/v3.10.0/onnx/PP-OCRv5/rec/ch_PP-OCRv5_rec_mobile.onnx

These model weights and their extracted dictionaries retain the Apache-2.0
license and the upstream notices included with this package. They are not
trained on, extracted from, or copied from another browser extension.
